steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 15-second launch film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, 30 fps.

Before you design anything, learn the product: read [your product URL], and the codebase if you have it. Write down in one line what it does and who it is for, list its three strongest features, and show me that summary first.

Story:
1. Hook: the studio's name and one line on what it makes.
2. Three case studies, one beat each: the client, the challenge and the result.
3. The craft: a montage of the best visuals from those projects.
4. End card: logo and how to get in touch.

Look and motion: punchy and modern: a cut every half second to a second, bold type, strong contrast, in the product's colours.

Write it for [your studio or agency]: read its case studies first and pull the real results from them.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.

original.label: Prompt
original.text: make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible work Studio1 is doing, you will get relevant info from case study, create like it's a good showreel for a Studio1 intro launch. go all out.
